business_ops.supply_chain_integration: Closed-loop / backward-integrated circular model: the Company runs in-house procurement of waste material, sorting, recycling and production, converting end-of-life energy storage products (used lead-acid batteries) and non-ferrous scrap into pure lead and lead alloy ingots at a single owned Manufacturing Facility in District Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh (7.61 acres, 104,025 MTPA installed). Backward linkage is through a global sourcing network — raw materials imported from forty-nine (49) countries plus domestic scrap and metal trading firms, dealers and auction platforms, with import purchases rising from 23.05% of total purchases in Fiscal 2023 to 64.73% in Fiscal 2025; MoEFCC licensing requirements for lead scrap imports form a high entry barrier that the Company states it clears through low-emission technology investment and a record of regulatory compliance. Quality is controlled in-house via a testing laboratory aligning output with customer specifications. Forward linkage is through direct supply to lead-acid battery manufacturers and metal customers (the facility is deliberately sited near large battery manufacturers such as Amara Raja Energy & Mobility for short turnaround and lower logistics cost) and near Chennai (150 Kms), Kattupalli (130 Kms) and Ennore (130 Kms) ports for import of raw materials and export of finished products, supported by dedicated bulk storage areas for raw materials and finished products. Price risk across this chain is managed by a board-approved hedging framework: a back-to-back pricing model linking quoted prices to LME at order confirmation for both import and export transactions, and futures/derivative contracts exclusively on the LME, typically covering 60%-100% of exposure through forward contracts, with positions dynamically closed when buyers are confirmed. Planned further integration: converting internally generated plastic scrap/chips into plastic granules and refining/recycling tin and copper waste products on a 5.56-acre site at Menakur (V), Naidupet (M), Tirupati District provisionally allotted by APIIC. Sustainability inputs are integrated into the process — oxygen enrichment during manufacturing to reduce furnace-oil dependence, and green fuel derived from end-of-life tyres in place of coal and oil.

overview.business_model: The Company manufactures pure lead and lead alloys - lead calcium, lead antimony, lead tin, lead silver and lead cadmium alloys - by processing recyclable scrap such as battery scrap, remelted lead ingots, remelted lead blocks, lead scrap (Radio/Relay/Ropes) and lead master metal.
